Based on the analysis of the geometric features, specifically the connection points and the shape of the cut edges, the third piece is Option B.

The two shown pieces form a 5-part chain (Piece 1 - Square - Piece 3 - Square - Piece 2). Piece B fits perfectly between the two squares and its outer "wings" and vertical edges allow it to connect with the two larger pieces to complete the square.

Answer: B
